note: THE RATCHET. This list is the STANDING DEBT, and it may only SHRINK. It is asserted TIGHT IN BOTH DIRECTIONS by tests/e2e-page-rooted-locators.test.ts: a site in the tree that is not listed here FAILS (no new site may be written), and an entry here that no longer matches the tree FAILS (whoever converts a site deletes its row). Do NOT regenerate this file to make the guard green — regenerating is how a ratchet becomes a rubber stamp. Convert the site, then delete the one line.
predicate: scripts/enumerate-page-locators.mjs — ONE predicate, shared with tests/helpers/pageLocatorInventory.json. The guard runs it with --worktree.
reseed: RE-SEEDED ONCE, BEFORE THIS GUARD LANDED — not a re-cut of a live ratchet. The first seed was taken at 65116fb19; #2809 and #2811 then merged to main carrying two new specs (acceptance-approved-status, acceptance-approvals-tab) with 32 page-rooted sites between them, and the merge queue — which builds this branch MERGED INTO main — was the first tree to see them. Seeded as it stood, the guard would have been red on main the day it shipped, the exact outcome its header set out to avoid. Those 32 sites are STANDING DEBT: they were on main before this guard existed, so banking them is what the baseline means. The ratchet binds from the moment this merges; after that the note above is the rule, without exception. They are NOT a conversion follow-up: both specs are workbench/board surfaces, not one of the six incident surfaces, so they fall in the PERMITTED set that docs/decisions/page-rooted-locator-disposition.md settles — that record asks the reader who sees a count and reaches for a sweep not to re-open it.
shrink: SHRUNK ONCE BY A PREDICATE CHANGE, NOT BY A REGENERATION (MOTIR-5186, 2026-09-11). 169 rows left the list because they left the DEFECT CLASS: a page-rooted locator whose parsed tail ends in a `toHaveCount` assertion cannot throw strict mode, because the matcher resolves the whole match set instead of asking for one element — the same mechanism that has always exempted .first()/.nth()/.last(). The note above forbids REGENERATING this file to silence the guard, and that prohibition is untouched: nothing here was converted, nothing was silenced, and no site that can still throw left the list. It shrank from 1189 to 1020 at faeb26e61, measured with the scanner itself; the removed set is EXACTLY the rows the scanner now marks exempt: ".toHaveCount()" (comm -23 = 169, comm -13 = 0, both under LC_ALL=C). The guard's own "no exempt row was banked" assertion REQUIRES this removal — an exempt row left in the list fails it.
remedy: getByRole(<role>, { name }) — the accessibility tree excludes the streamed and outgoing copies. Where the node carries no role, scope to a live subtree instead (a dialog, a named region, page.getByRole('main')).
